params.name: profile
params.description: User profile ID. If parameter is omitted, defaults to user's personal profile

params.name: status
params.description: Comma separated list of one or more status codes to filter transfers. See [Tracking Transfers](/guides/product/send-money/tracking-transfers) for complete list of statuses

params.name: createdDateStart
params.description: Starting date to filter transfers, inclusive of the provided date

params.name: createdDateEnd
params.description: Ending date to filter transfers, inclusive of the provided date

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to be returned in response

items.docs:
Get the list of transfers for a given user's profile (defaults to user's personal profile).

You can add query parameters to specify user's profile (personal or business), time period and/or payment status. For example, you can query all failed payments created since last week, or all completed payments created since yesterday.

Transfers may be cancelled up until the transfer has been processed and funds converted. Cancellation is final — it cannot be undone.

{% admonition type="info" name="When can a transfer be cancelled?" %}
A transfer can only be cancelled programmatically via the API if it meets **all** of the following criteria:

- The transfer is not in `funds_converted` or later state.
- There are no processing problems with the transfer.

Create a transfer on behalf of a third party.

When creating a third party transfer:
- The `originator` datablock is **required**. This details the ultimate sender of funds in the transfer.
- Depending on the legal entity type of the originator (`PRIVATE` or `BUSINESS`), the required fields vary.
- `originalTransferId` field must be used. This is your own ID for the transfer.

Fetch completed payments used to fund the transfer.

In most cases there should only be a single payment associated with the transfer. There are rare occasions that a transfer can be funded with multiple payment methods and when this occurs the first completed payment method would be used to calculate the fees provided on the quote.

Fetch banking reference information for transfers that are in `outgoing_payment_sent` status, enabling you to track transfers with the transfer recipient's bank.

It may take up to 3 days to get the correct information through this endpoint, as some partners don't share the information until 3 days later.

info.name: Get a US combined disclosure receipt

items.docs: Download US combined receipt in PDF format for transfers that are in status `incoming_payment_initiated` and again when the status is updated to `outgoing_payment_sent`.

Download transfer non objection certificate in PDF format for transfers that are in status `outgoing_payment_sent`.

This document can be used to obtain a Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) from the bank that paid out the transfer.

This is only applicable to INR payments with either a business sender or recipient.
